expectations.text: Every shot prompt is self-contained: camera, lighting or style, palette and audio all appear inside the same prompt text
expectations.evidence: Style lives in a separate 03-style-block.txt; of 8 prompt blocks, 0 contain lighting, audio or avoid inline — the exact hand-merge the user has to repeat 8 times

expectations.text: Names one explicit consistency anchor — a concrete recurring visual element repeated across all shots
expectations.evidence: Anchor named: brown wool coat with missing top button, green headscarf, leather case, repeated word for word

expectations.text: Answers the stated continuity worry with concrete mechanisms, naming at least two of: fixed seed, repeated palette wording, last-frame chaining, shared grade pass
expectations.evidence: Identical style block pasted every time, plus grade + grain pass and a single unbroken audio bed

expectations.text: Every shot prompt carries an avoid / negative list
Warns that a specific real person cannot be held identical across clips, and offers a way around it
expectations.evidence: Strong: do not show her face, use real photographs for the person

expectations.text: Proposes a narrative spine for the piece rather than only a list of pretty images
expectations.evidence: Full arc from ordinary morning through the border to dawn

expectations.text: Shot count is derived from the 60s runtime and a stated clip length
